stageA.sourceMathematics: Three-dimensional solids such as cubes, rectangular prisms, cylinders and cones differ in flat/curved surfaces, faces, edges and vertices. A cube has6 square faces,12 edges,8 vertices; a cylinder has2 circular flat faces and curved surface.
stageA.studentFacingAuthenticTask: Original student GROUP creates poster to describe a REAL assigned solid using words, numerals and drawings. Peers guess the solid from attributes and compare multiple posters.
stageA.originalMediaAndHumanLimits: Actual three-dimensional physical model, exposed surfaces and image-based teacher group tasks are human evaluated.
